text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Ah, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Based on the current training progress, I 
was hoping to discuss what we should do 
going forward.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is highly motivated, after all. 
It's only natural that they would learn so 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this, we might be able to raise the 
bar just a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive's evaluation seems to be 
stellar!
